qualified_context.b6n2_successor_authority: RESTRICTED_CONDITIONAL_PLATE_LOCAL_RIGID_KINEMATICS; does not classify individual interface segments, define extension/accommodation, or authorize topology change

scope.purpose: Specify the minimum future model interface needed for an adaptive engine to evolve a rift-process candidate and assess structural/interface/support transition predicates at runtime.

model_identity: applicable authority contract IDs and scope
initialization_inputs: active local spatial scope and proven dependency/buffer scope

evolved_state_requirement.meaning: Smallest sufficient set of model state variables needed by the selected evolution law and its governed transition predicates. B6N7 does not assume a scalar extension, opening distance, width, or crustal-thinning variable is sufficient.
evolved_state_requirement.units_domain_and_support: Each component must declare physical meaning, units, valid range/domain, support identity, initialization, evolution law, authority, and uncertainty; unknown fields remain UNKNOWN.
evolved_state_requirement.state_vs_diagnostic: Evolved internal state is distinct from kinematic diagnostics, forcing, parameters, predicates, and persistent WORLD_HISTORY state.

forcing_inputs.name: B6N2_pair_plate_rigid_kinematics
forcing_inputs.current_blocker: No selected positive-duration interval; B6N5/B6N4-R1 event, topology, interface and support prerequisites remain unresolved.
forcing_inputs.derivable_from_existing_authority: Relative rigid motion diagnostics only, within explicit successor-model scope and validity; not physical extension, opening, boundary type, or accommodation.

forcing_inputs.name: POST_EVENT_interface_geometry_and_identity
forcing_inputs.rule: Preserve the exact 71-segment pair interface and junction/support identities until a separately governed transition application.

forcing_inputs.name: additional_thermal_lithospheric_mantle_load_weakness_or_external_forcing
forcing_inputs.rule: Require only if the selected scientific law depends on it; then specify source authority, scope, resolution, uncertainty, and replay identity. None is presumed by B6N7.

evolution_law.minimum_class: GOVERNED_PROCESS_EVOLUTION_LAW; exact class remains model-selection dependent
evolution_law.rule: Every evolved state component and interface response output must bind to an explicit law, inputs, authority and valid scope. Do not invent an equation, coefficient, threshold, or constitutive closure.

interface_response_requirement.observable: A support-resolved, model-authorized response/regime assessment mapped to the existing interface identity and any required junction/buffer scope.
interface_response_requirement.resolution_rule: Model must state whether its response is pair-level, segment-level, or another explicit support; no uniform segment reclassification is inferred.
interface_response_requirement.unknown_rule: Missing segment semantics or response remains UNKNOWN; rigid relative motion does not supply it.

per_predicate_fields: signed margin or equivalent when physically defined
transition application authority reference or NONE
predicate_outputs.semantics: PREDICATE != EVENT != TRANSITION APPLICATION. A predicate can require a stop, event candidate, refinement, or a new authority stage; it never invents a topology/state outcome.

adaptive_indicators: evolved-state rate or equivalent change indicator
predicate margin/proximity and change rate where defined
event detection coverage and bracket width
minimum_interface.uncertainty_rule: Keep dimensions and support explicit; represent as ranges/distributions/covariance or UNKNOWN only where justified. Do not collapse to one unsupported confidence scalar.

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Only if the selected law consumes it; not a universal rift state.

assessment.why_needed: Supply a motion diagnostic/forcing to a model that explicitly uses relative plate motion.
assessment.authority: EXISTING_ARCANA_MODEL_AUTHORITY plus DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION within B6N2 scope
assessment.external_scientific_calibration_required: NO_FOR_KINEMATIC_DIAGNOSTIC; YES only if interpreted as physical extension/response
assessment.scope: Pair 1:3 and only its authorized plate-local representations/valid interval
runtime_consumers: predicate input only where explicitly authorized

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Not adopted as universal state; may be a diagnostic/input only after orientation, side, sign, support, and physical meaning are governed.

assessment.why_needed: Could quantify normal separation/loading if the selected process law defines interface orientation and extension semantics.
assessment.authority: AUTHORIAL_MODEL_DECISION plus scientific law authority if given physical response meaning
assessment.scope: Declared interface segments or model-defined aggregate with explicit mapping; no assumed uniformity
runtime_consumers: adaptive event proximity only after the quantity is authorized

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Only if a selected law demonstrates sufficiency for its process/interface predicates; cannot be inferred from pair motion alone.

assessment.why_needed: A candidate progress memory for an extension-dependent process threshold; its necessity and sufficiency are unproven.
assessment.derivable_from_existing_plate_kinematics: NO_AS_PHYSICAL_OPENING; accumulated rigid relative motion alone is only a diagnostic
assessment.mechanics_required: UNKNOWN; a justified reduced-order law might not require full mechanics
assessment.scope: Active rift interface and declared dependency/buffer scope
runtime_consumers: state significance if persistent effects are governed

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Not required unless the selected law needs spatial localization/averaging; requires explicit spatial meaning, support and authority.

assessment.why_needed: Could define where an extended deformation law applies, but no width is currently governed.
assessment.authority: AUTHORIAL_MODEL_DECISION; EXTERNAL_SCIENTIFIC_MODEL_OR_LITERATURE_CALIBRATION if physical width is claimed
assessment.mechanics_required: NO_BY_DEFINITION; selected width law may require physical model authority
assessment.scope: Local rift region plus proven buffer/dependency scope

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Not required merely to detect a structural-event candidate; required if crustal thinning/creation is claimed or requested.

assessment.why_needed: Represents crustal evolution only if that physical output is within the selected model scope.
assessment.scope: Only requested rift/crust domain and its declared dependencies

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Not universal; requires a defined reference geometry/thickness and governed relation to model state.

assessment.why_needed: May summarize finite extension in a selected crustal/lithospheric model but is not required for abstract process-predicate evaluation.

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: A support-resolved response/regime assessment is required to close PLATE_INTERFACE_EVENT_PREDICATES; no discrete class is selected here.

assessment.why_needed: Determine whether the model's interface response remains within its law or requires event/refinement/authority transition.
assessment.authority: AUTHORIAL_MODEL_DECISION plus external physical model authority where regime is physical
assessment.derivable_from_existing_plate_kinematics: NO; kinematics alone does not classify type, polarity, or response
assessment.mechanics_required: NOT_PROVEN; response may be reduced-order only if scientifically justified
assessment.scope: Explicitly declared segment/group identities and adjacent junction/buffer support

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Topology invalidation/reevaluation predicate coverage and candidate transition scope are required; application needs separate transition authority.

assessment.why_needed: Detect when current graph/topology invariants cease to be valid for the candidate process trajectory.
assessment.mechanics_required: NOT_INHERENT; physical event trigger remains model-dependent
assessment.scope: Affected graph closure; expand when dependencies cannot be isolated

candidate_quantity_adjudication.minimum_required: Report whether declared support identities remain valid and which scopes require reevaluation; never silently remap membership.

assessment.why_needed: Prevent candidate outputs from consuming stale or ambiguous spatial membership after an interface/topology event.
assessment.authority: ARCANA_SUPPORT_IDENTITY_RULE plus explicit successor remapping authority if membership changes
assessment.derivable_from_existing_plate_kinematics: NO; motion does not define membership validity
assessment.external_scientific_calibration_required: NO_FOR_IDENTITY_CHECK; YES only for any physical rule that triggers reassignment
assessment.scope: Affected node/cell/interface/junction supports and dependent records
runtime_consumers: support remapping stage if separately authorized

runtime_observables: covered transition classes and detector coverage
b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.closing_predicate_requirement: A model-scoped, conservative topology-reevaluation/invalidation predicate set covering the applicable event classes; exact transition outcome remains separately governed.
b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.dependency: Topology transition coverage directly informs support-validity checks; a common authority is not presumed.

b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.closing_predicate_requirement: Governed next-process/regime validity predicate evaluated from evolved state; no exact future time is required if detector can bracket the crossing.
b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.dependency: Process evolution is direct; implications for interfaces/topology are derived only through explicit predicates.

runtime_observables: pair motion only where law consumes it
b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.closing_predicate_requirement: Per declared interface support, report regime/response validity and transitions; no boundary type or polarity is inferred from rigid kinematics.
minimum_state_or_input: interface identity and explicitly declared model response support
b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.dependency: Interface transitions can trigger topology reevaluation, but are not themselves topology application.

b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.closing_predicate_requirement: Conservatively indicate when support is valid, invalid, or UNKNOWN and identify the exact scope requiring an explicit remap/transition authority.
b6n4r1_blocker_matrix.dependency: Derived from topology/interface evidence and explicit support rules; no automatic membership reassignment.

runtime_predicate_contract.scope: active rift process and declared dependencies
runtime_predicate_contract.crossing: Exact future crossing time is not a required model input. Bracketable only if predicate continuity/detector conditions are governed; otherwise report UNKNOWN and stop affected scope.
on_approach_or_crossing: bracket/refine if numerical/event uncertainty is refinable
emit event candidate when evidence supports crossing
stop/isolate and request successor model authority at validity boundary
runtime_predicate_contract.persistent_pre_post: Only when an authorized state transition is applied and state significance requires it; predicate crossing alone does not create new topology.

required_inputs: pair kinematics only if authorized input
runtime_predicate_contract.scope: declared affected segments/junctions plus dependency buffer
runtime_predicate_contract.crossing: Record evidence-supported bracket if detector is governed.
on_approach_or_crossing: emit event candidate or preserve UNKNOWN
require a separate response/transition application decision
runtime_predicate_contract.persistent_pre_post: Required only for adjudicated state-significant transition/application, not a diagnostic predicate alone.

runtime_predicate_contract.scope: minimum affected topology closure; expand if dependencies are not isolated
runtime_predicate_contract.crossing: May be bracketed as a candidate invalidation; resulting graph is not implied.
on_approach_or_crossing: stop affected scope before using invalid topology
invoke separately authorized topology transition model/application
runtime_predicate_contract.persistent_pre_post: No topology successor unless separate transition authority constructs and validates it.

runtime_predicate_contract.crossing: Report VALID/INVALID/UNKNOWN bracket where support rule permits.
on_approach_or_crossing: stop affected scope if validity is not established
require explicit support remap authority before changing membership
runtime_predicate_contract.persistent_pre_post: Only when a governed membership transition is applied and significant; no inferred reassignment.

model_tiers.capability: Restricted relative rigid-motion diagnostics for plate pair 1:3.
model_tiers.insufficiency: No post-activation process evolution law, segment response semantics, topology event coverage, or support-validity predicate.

model_tiers.capability: Could integrate a governed extension/displacement diagnostic if interface frame, sign, support and meaning are explicitly supplied.
model_tiers.insufficiency: Kinematic displacement alone does not govern rift process state, interface accommodation/regime, event criteria, or topology/support validity; adding those rules turns this into a process model.

model_tiers.capability: Model-defined minimal evolving process state, authorized evolution/response law, support-resolved interface outputs and conservative runtime predicates for process/interface/topology/support reassessment.
model_tiers.mechanics_required: NOT_PROVEN; a non-mechanical reduced-order law may qualify only if its scientific basis, scope, uncertainty and transition coverage are justified.

model_tiers.capability: Adds thickness/thinning, stretching, width or crustal state predictions and corresponding physical couplings.
model_tiers.required_when: Only when those physical state outputs or their consequences are in the requested authority scope.

model_tiers.capability: Can resolve stress/strain/force balance and mechanical failure/accommodation when those are required outputs.

lowest_sufficient_tier_decision.decision_meaning: Lowest model class to investigate for the four dynamic blocker families; not a selected, validated, calibrated, or authorized model.
lowest_sufficient_tier_decision.why_tier_1_does_not_close: Relative motion/extension diagnostics do not supply process evolution, segment response regime, conservative transition detector coverage, or support validity semantics.
lowest_sufficient_tier_decision.external_research: REQUIRED_BEFORE_SCIENTIFIC_MODEL_SELECTION to establish physically meaningful state variables/laws/predicates, their domain, uncertainty and whether reduced-order/type-agnostic response is defensible.
